critical_code_review_comments: tenant_config_resolver.py: STORE_NAVIGATION_TREE is a hardcoded constant. Sound choice for STORE-001 sprint scope (curated showroom path), but main agent should consider future-proofing if store-mode items become per-tenant configurable.

Cache TTL=60s with no programmatic invalidation hook reachable from outside the process — flipping is_store_mode via raw SQL requires backend restart (or 60s wait) for changes to take effect. Test handles this via supervisorctl restart; in production an admin PATCH endpoint to set is_store_mode would auto-invalidate.

Early return in resolve_navigation() when is_store_mode=True bypasses navigation_overrides (hide_modules, hide_groups, rename_sections). Acceptable since store mode is itself an override, but worth documenting if tenants in store mode set overrides expecting them to apply.
